mission: Principles of Intelligence is a nonprofit that grows the AI safety field by bringing in ideas from the natural and social sciences — physics, biology, economics, complex systems. It runs the PIBBSS Fellowship, which pairs researchers from other fields with AI safety mentors, plus coordinated research programmes and an internal research team. It aims to build rigorous scientific foundations for understanding AI systems.

key_work.title: PIBBSS Fellowship
key_work.plain_summary: A 3-month programme pairing about 20 fellows from complex-systems sciences with AI safety mentors to work on projects bridging their field and AI safety.

key_work.title: Coordinated Research Programs
key_work.plain_summary: Builds collaboration networks with researchers outside traditional AI safety to open up new technical directions.

key_work.title: Publications / research highlights
key_work.plain_summary: Papers from the internal team and fellows on learning theory, interpretability tools, data models and economics of AI agents.

status_note: PIBBSS (Principles of Intelligent Behavior in Biological and Social Systems) rebranded its umbrella organisation as Principles of Intelligence; the PIBBSS Fellowship continues under it
status_raw: renamed — PIBBSS (Principles of Intelligent Behavior in Biological and Social Systems) rebranded its umbrella organisation as Principles of Intelligence; the PIBBSS Fellowship continues under it

warnings.text: We lack a rigorous scientific understanding of how AI systems work, which makes robust, scalable alignment hard.
AI safety draws on too narrow a set of disciplines and ideas.

recommendations.text: Bring physicists, biologists, economists and philosophers into AI safety research.
Fund blue-sky, foundational research and incubate new research agendas into independent organisations.
